intro: NSW HSC courses for Years 11 and 12. Codes such as MTH1011 are Tutor Compass category codes, not NESA course numbers. A tutor only matches when they teach the exact course and year. Course names are the official English titles.

findTutorHint: Choose the student's course. Sharing a category code is not enough: a tutor for Mathematics Standard 2 is not a match for Mathematics Advanced.
tutorsHint: The exact courses and years each tutor teaches.
onlyOwner: Only the owner can change these.
addToTutor: Add a course to a tutor
studentsHint: The courses each student is studying, kept with their family record.
bookingsHint: Bookings keep their original subject text. Linking one to an exact course lets Tutor Compass check the tutor really teaches it.
linkBooking: Link a booking to a course
offeredCount_one: {{count}} course and year pair is switched on for this business.
offeredCount_other: {{count}} course and year pairs are switched on for this business.
switchOn: Switch a course on when the business starts offering it.
ownerSwitches: Only the owner can switch courses on or off.
notConfirmedHint: Details that weren't checked course by course. They are noted here rather than guessed.
askCompass: Ask Compass AI things like “who teaches Maths Advanced Year 12?” or see the Knowledge Hub for owner rules:
